title: Healthcare & Medical Privacy Policy Template - HIPAA Compliant
metaDescription: Free HIPAA-compliant privacy policy template for healthcare providers, medical apps, and health services. Protect patient data legally.
description: Comprehensive privacy policy template designed for healthcare providers, medical practices, and health apps. Ensures HIPAA compliance while clearly explaining how patient medical information is collected, used, and protected.

sections.heading: Privacy Policy Overview
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how [ORGANIZATION_NAME] collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your protected health information (PHI) and personal information. We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other applicable privacy laws.

Effective Date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]
Last Updated: [LAST_UPDATED]

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect and maintain several types of information:

**Protected Health Information (PHI):**
- Medical history and treatment records
- Diagnostic test results and imaging
- Prescription and medication information
- Insurance and billing information
- Appointment and scheduling data

**Personal Information:**
- Name, address, phone number, email
- Date of birth and Social Security number
- Emergency contact information
- [ADDITIONAL_INFO_TYPES]

**Technical Information (for digital services):**
- Device information and IP addresses
- Usage logs and application analytics
- Location data (only when necessary for services)

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
We use your protected health information for:

**Treatment:** Providing, coordinating, and managing your healthcare services
**Payment:** Processing insurance claims and billing for services
**Healthcare Operations:** Quality improvement, staff training, and business operations

**Other permitted uses include:**
- Public health reporting as required by law
- Research (with proper authorization)
- Emergency situations to protect health and safety
- Legal proceedings when required by court order
- [SPECIFIC_USE_CASES]

We will never sell your health information to third parties or use it for marketing without your explicit written authorization.

placeholders.label: Organization-Specific Use Cases
placeholders.defaultValue: Coordination with specialists and referral providers

sections.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content:
We may share your information with:

**Healthcare Providers:** Other doctors, specialists, laboratories, and healthcare facilities involved in your care
**Business Associates:** Third-party service providers who help us operate (billing companies, IT support, cloud storage providers)
**Insurance Companies:** For payment and coverage determination
**Family Members:** Only with your written permission or in emergency situations

**Legal Disclosures:**
We may disclose information when required by law, including:
- Court orders and subpoenas
- Public health authorities
- Law enforcement (in limited circumstances)
- Workers' compensation cases

All business associates sign agreements requiring them to protect your information according to HIPAA standards.

sections.heading: Data Security and Protection
sections.content:
We implement comprehensive safeguards to protect your information:

**Physical Safeguards:**
- Secure facilities with controlled access
- Locked filing cabinets for paper records
- Secure disposal of documents containing PHI

**Technical Safeguards:**
- Encryption for data transmission and storage
- Secure user authentication and access controls
- Regular security updates and monitoring
- Firewalls and intrusion detection systems

**Administrative Safeguards:**
- HIPAA training for all staff members
- Regular security risk assessments
- Incident response procedures
- Background checks for employees with PHI access

**Data Retention:**
We retain your health information for [RETENTION_PERIOD] or as required by law. When information is no longer needed, it is securely destroyed.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.content:
Under HIPAA, you have the right to:

**Access:** Request copies of your health information
**Amendment:** Request corrections to your health information
**Restriction:** Request limits on how we use or share your information
**Alternative Communication:** Request we contact you in a specific way or location
**Accounting:** Receive a list of disclosures we've made of your information
**Breach Notification:** Be notified if your information is compromised

**To Exercise Your Rights:**
Contact our Privacy Officer at [PRIVACY_CONTACT] or submit a written request to [MAILING_ADDRESS]. We will respond within 30 days.

**Complaints:**
If you believe your privacy rights have been violated, you may file a complaint with us or with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights.

sections.heading: Digital Services and Apps
sections.content:
If we provide mobile apps or online portals:

**Account Security:**
- Use strong, unique passwords
- Enable two-factor authentication when available
- Log out after each session, especially on shared devices
- Consider using Incognito Browser for additional privacy when accessing health portals

**Data Collection:**
- We collect only information necessary for healthcare services
- Location data is used only when required for specific features
- Analytics are anonymized and used for service improvement

**Third-Party Integration:**
- We may integrate with wearable devices or health apps with your consent
- You control what data is shared from external sources
- Integration agreements include privacy protections

**Mobile Security:**
- Use device locks and biometric authentication
- Keep apps updated to the latest version
- Be cautious when using public Wi-Fi for health-related activities

sections.heading: Special Protections
sections.content:
Certain health information receives additional protection:

**Mental Health Information:** Psychotherapy notes and mental health treatment records have enhanced privacy protections
**Substance Abuse Treatment:** Subject to federal confidentiality regulations (42 CFR Part 2)
**Reproductive Health:** Additional state law protections may apply to reproductive health services
**Genetic Information:** Protected under the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act (GINA)
**HIV/AIDS Information:** Subject to special state confidentiality laws

**Minors' Rights:**
- Parents/guardians typically have access to minors' health information
- State laws may provide privacy rights for minors regarding certain services
- We follow applicable state laws regarding consent and confidentiality

**Research Participation:**
If you participate in research, additional privacy protections apply, including institutional review board oversight and specific consent procedures.

sections.heading: Policy Updates and Contact Information
sections.content:
**Policy Changes:**
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Material changes will be posted prominently and, when required by law, we will obtain your consent. The current version is always available at [POLICY_URL].

**Contact Information:**
Privacy Officer: [PRIVACY_OFFICER_NAME]
Email: [PRIVACY_EMAIL]
Phone: [PRIVACY_PHONE]
Mailing Address: [PRIVACY_ADDRESS]

**Business Hours for Privacy Inquiries:**
[BUSINESS_HOURS]

**Emergency Situations:**
In medical emergencies, we may need to override normal privacy procedures to protect your health and safety. We will limit disclosures to the minimum necessary and document any emergency disclosures.
